// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1915): a typed constant (`const P: typeof Image = withUniwind(Image)`) and the
// generic call `withUniwind<P>(Image)`, both withUniwind (the real wrapper idiom), plus a typed plain alias. No prop.
import { Image } from 'react-native';
import { withUniwind } from 'uniwind';
const Typed: typeof Image = withUniwind(Image);
const Generic = withUniwind<{ uri: string }>(Image);
const Both: typeof Image = withUniwind<{ uri: string }>(Image);
const Alias: typeof Image = Image;
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Typed source={{ uri }} />
      <Generic source={{ uri }} />
      <Both source={{ uri }} />
      <Alias source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
